CLAUDE.md for synthcheck

Source: CLAUDE.md

This repository is an R package for the synthetic authenticity benchmark. It tests whether synthetic respondents generated by language models resemble real survey respondents, using three anchored indices (Overlap, Structure, Behaviour) and a single benchmark score. The design, the decisions made so far and the work plan are in PROJECT_BRIEF.md. Read it before starting any work.

Rules

  • Owner’s decisions are fixed unless Okan changes them: The target is all real respondents (clean_real = TRUE is the alternative). Three anchored columns, with the weakest as the default score, which users can change. Exactly eight behaviour features. Response time and text features are out of scope.
  • Standalone package. Do not depend on mirtverse. Code ported from mirtverse keeps its GPL-3 license and credits mirtverse in the file header and in NEWS.
  • Simple, readable plots. One picture that reads at a glance. Use the coverage strip palette c("#c0302b", "#f0a09a", "#f0efec", "#86b6ef", "#1c5cab"): red means fewer or lower than real, blue means more or higher, pale means a match.
  • Prose style: Capitalize the first word after a colon in all prose (README, help pages, articles, NEWS). Skip code, function names, URLs, times, ratios and YAML.
  • Checks before a PR: devtools::document(), devtools::test() and R CMD check --as-cran with no errors or warnings. Keep slow fits (person-fit models on all 240 HEXACO items) in \donttest{} or behind skip_on_cran().
  • Data: HEXACO answers are raw 1 to 7. Reverse-keyed items (hexaco_items$reverse) are keyed with 8 - x. Missing values are NA.
  • The experimental status must be clear in the README and the help pages: The benchmark compares models and supports decisions about them. It does not show that synthetic data can replace a field test.
